text:
lucy: Quick heads-up from the Java sample app QA. On Android 14 emulator when OkHttp follows redirects a 307 causes the Authorization header to vanish on the redirected request. Pixel 5 (Android 12) doesn't show the problem.
ben: Is this only when followRedirects(true)?
lucy: yes. followRedirects(false) keeps the header.
harry: paste the interceptor and client config?
lucy: interceptor: `chain.request().newBuilder().addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")` Client: `OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(true).addInterceptor(auth).build()`
jo: try `.header(...)` (replace) instead of `addHeader`. Also try moving to addNetworkInterceptor to see if placement changes behavior.
lucy: `.header(...)` fixed the simple repro on emulator. Network interceptor also preserved header but broke our Authenticator refresh flow (Authenticator not seeing same call context).
ai-bot: created ticket INF-4210: "Authorization removed on 3xx redirect on Android 14 emulator". Linked sample repro.
ben: short-term docs: note the emulator-14 gotcha, recommend `.header(...)` or followRedirects(false) + manual redirect handling; long-term: add CI test on emulator-14.
harry: i'll add a MockWebServer test that asserts Authorization present after redirect and raise PR.
lucy: thanks — will update sample README with workarounds and include the minimal repro script.
